text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Belgian government grants 100 million Belgian Franc ($3.3 million) loan for Bosnia's post-war reconstruction.

- Bosnian ministry for foreign trade and international communication halts newly-reopened bus line from Sarajevo to Belgrade. The decision came after discriminatory behaviour by the Yugoslav side which violated an accord signed in Paris in July by the two governments.
- Bosnian Moslem house dynamited in the Croat-held part of the divided Bosnian town of Mostar early on Monday morning, the town's police department reports. --Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
